shortlist.title: Hologram Projector
shortlist.why_useful: A very compact display-adjacent object with a glowing holographic form; useful as a small visual focal point beside or above the existing classroom presentation wall. It is explicitly described only as a glowing sci-fi projector. The mesh does not establish projection, lighting, controls, or runtime behavior.

not_shortlisted.reason: Only small standalone chair surfaced with CC BY in the curated lore collection (123 kB), but its ornate high-backed velvet/baroque styling is a poor match for the Mars classroom.
Contains a plausible black office chair, desk and CRT, but it is a 32.1 MB office-corner scene with walls and a conventional office style, not a small modular classroom prop.

scope_note: Metadata-only audit. Originals and thumbnails remain in place; no files imported, downloaded, copied or modified. The shortlist has two items because no small suitable chair was found. Each chosen row carries explicit per-model CC Attribution (CC BY 4.0) metadata and an ATTRIBUTION.md source entry. Catalog scale/bounds are absent; displayed size is the GLB file size, not physical dimensions.
